items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You know Cock-Eye George? I was trying to make somebody know Cock-Eye George.

ctx.x: That's right. I remember playing with him.
He knew Cock-Eye George because he took me on a job with Cock-Eye George.
You know Cock-Eye George? I was trying to make somebody know Cock-Eye George.
